scope: Offline crop and fitting interventions on the six remaining failed collage cases plus two crop controls. Historical approximate corners are not ground truth. No runtime changes or newly counted automatic successes.

selectionRule.method: Joint chromaticity/brightness clustering, paper-color-specific lobes, multiple lower-line pairs
selectionRule.candidateSelection: Among candidates with both lobe supports >= 0.65 and both cap color losses <= 0.30, choose minimum outline-fitting loss. No template scores, historical corners, or source artwork are used. Cases without a candidate satisfying this rule receive no proposal.
selectionRule.scope: Exploratory crop hypothesis, not a production acceptance rule. The beam's raw line inlier denominator counts multiple transitions per row and is not comparable with production line support. Selected quadrilaterals must be independently inspected; geometric and image-template gates remain unchanged.
selectionRule.sourceCoordinateConvention: Prototype quads are source pixel centers; add 0.5 before engine preparation. No historical crop inset.

findings: Original jigsaw and bauble proposals visibly distort/cut the photographed motif.
Historical jigsaw and crossed-ribbons crops give substantially cleaner reconstructions; nested-squares grid remains uneven.
Historical Santa still reroutes much of the pictured silhouette. Bauble pale frame is absent in classified target before fitting.
Lobe-qualified nested-squares proposal cuts off much of the heart; rejected as a crop improvement regardless of fit.
Proposed outline-star and flower resemble their classified masks, but their physical crop corners are not independently certified. No automatic success claim.

validation.reason: Only frozen diagnostic records and documentation added; production implementation and benchmark/replay code match previously checked sources. Existing suite results are not represented as fresh tests.
